'''Thaln'k''' was a [[Gree (species)/Legends|Gree]] who visited the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Carrick Station]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Thaln'k was added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the release Game Update 3.2: Rise of the Emperor on [[April 28]], [[2015]]. Thaln'k and the [[Vaiken Spacedock]] counterpart [[Hathe'k]] sell the "White Acute Module," which is an item that can disable the promotional 12x experience boost provided to players starting on [[May 4]].<ref name="TOR" />
